title: CPC-2026-3542-GPA-ZC
text:
CPC-2026-3542-GPA-ZC  Council District: 7 – Rodriguez
  CEQA: CF 23-0929  Last Day to Act: 10-08-26
  Plan Area: Sylmar

  PUBLIC HEARING REQUIRED

  PROJECT SITE:  16300 Foothill Boulevard

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  Construction, use, and maintenance of a new two-story Los Angeles Fire Department fire station (Station No.
  31) on a 35,067 square-foot vacant lot.

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. Pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Article 19, Section 15332 (Class 32),
  an exemption from CEQA and there is no substantial evidence demonstrating that an exception to a
  categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Section 15300.2 applies;
  2. Pursuant to City Charter Section 555 and Section 11.5.6 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC), a
  General Plan Amendment to the Sylmar Community Plan from Limited Industrial to Public Facilities; and
  3. Pursuant to LAMC Section 12.32, a Zone Change from [Q]M1-1 to (T)PF-1.

  Applicant:  City of Los Angeles

  Staff:  Dang Nguyen, City Planner
  dang.nguyen@lacity.org
  (818) 374-5027
summary: Construction of a new two-story Los Angeles Fire Department Fire Station No. 31 at 16300 Foothill Boulevard in Sylmar.

details.action: General Plan Amendment and Zone Change for fire station construction
